# **GUIDELINES ON CLAIM PROCESSING FOR GROUP LIFE INSURANCE** 

The Authority vide Circular ref: IRDA/LIFE/CIR/GDU285/12/2014 dated December 29, 

Policies/Schemes administered by the following entities as Group Organisers/Master Policyholders: 

2. NBFCs having Certificate of Registration from RBI. 

- The Authority is in receipt of a request seeking inclusion of Scheduled Cooperative Banks, Primary Cooperative Banks, State Cooperative Credit Societies and MFls registered under Sec. 25 of the Companies Act, 1956 or Sec 8 of the Companies Act 

- Banks with RBI regulated Scheduled Banks (including Co-operative Banks). All other conditions mentioned in the above circular remain unchanged.
